title: Dyadic shells of a current represented by a finite measure: shell integrals, convergence of the shell series, supports and masses
statement: Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (S) (verbatim the frozen Lean type of the selected node's resolved dependency with key support_calculus, the support calculus of currents on ℝ^P): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, (i) if E ⊆ ℝ^P is closed and X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) satisfies X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) whose tsupport is disjoint from E, then spt X ⊆ E; (ii) spt X is closed for every X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P); (iii) spt(A − B) ⊆ spt A ∪ spt B for A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P); (iv) spt 0 = ∅; (v) spt ∂A ⊆ spt A for A ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P); and (ML) (verbatim the frozen Lean type of the accepted declaration cmc_fcl_massOn_le_measure_inter, the selected node's resolved dependency with key mass_le_measure): for P, d ∈ ℕ, any U ⊆ ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_d(U), a measure μ, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_d and sets E, V ⊆ ℝ^P, if |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every d-covector α for μ-a.e. x and X(ω) = ∫_E ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), then M_V(X) ≤ μ(E ∩ V). Let P, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), A, Y : ℕ → 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), μ a measure on ℝ^P, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_k, d : ℝ^P → ℝ and r : ℕ → ℝ. Assume: μ is a finite measure; ξ is μ-a.e. strongly measurable; for μ-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for every k-covector α; μ(ℝ^P \ spt X) = 0; d is continuous; r is strictly decreasing (StrictAnti); μ({d < r_j}) → 0 as j → ∞; X(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x), A_j(ω) = ∫_{d<r_j} ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) (for every j), Y_0(ω) = X(ω) − A_0(ω) and Y_{j+1}(ω) = A_j(ω) − A_{j+1}(ω) (for every j), for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P). Then, for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) and j ∈ ℕ: (a) Y_0(ω) = ∫_{r_0≤d} ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) and Y_{j+1}(ω) = ∫_{r_{j+1}≤d<r_j} ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x), the domains being {x : r_0 ≤ d(x)} and {x : r_{j+1} ≤ d(x) ∧ d(x) < r_j}; (b) Σ_j Y_j(ω) = X(ω) (HasSum (j ↦ Y_j(ω)) (X(ω))); (c) spt Y_j ⊆ spt X ∩ {x : r_j ≤ d(x)} and spt A_j ⊆ spt X; (d) M(Y_0) ≤ μ(ℝ^P) and M(Y_{j+1}) ≤ μ({d < r_j}). Conventions (as in the frozen contract and SimonGMT Chapter06): ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k; X(ω) is the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); 0 is the zero current; ∂X = X.boundary with ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply); currents with equal values are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). Λ_k = MultiVector P k (continuous linear functionals on k-covectors) and |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α (Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector). M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support = U \ X.zeroRegion, where X.zeroRegion is the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). Integrals ∫_E g dμ are Bochner integrals over μ⌞E; {d < t} abbreviates {x : d(x) < t}.
